item.title: Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔)
item.description: Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔) Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔, Lai Ping-tung) was a Taiwanese Presbyterian pastor, Bible Society pioneer, and evangelist.

item.title: Thomas Barclay (巴克禮)
item.description: Thomas Barclay (巴克禮) Thomas Barclay (巴克禮, POJ: Pa-khek-lé, 21 November 1849 – 5 October 1935) was a Scottish missionary of the Presbyterian Church of England.

item.title: Rev. Pinghsi Liu (劉炳熹)
item.description: Rev. Pinghsi Liu (劉炳熹) Rev. Pinghsi Liu (劉炳熹) is a PCT pastor. From 14 September 2020 he was 第十任 pastor of 台南東門巴克禮紀念教會.

item.title: Presbyterian Church in Taiwan (PCT)
item.description: Presbyterian Church in Taiwan (PCT) The Presbyterian Church in Taiwan (PCT) (Chinese: 台灣基督長老教會; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Tâi-oân Ki-tok Tiúⁿ-ló Kàu-hōe) is the largest Protestant Christian denomination based in Taiwan.

item.title: Tainan East Gate Barclay Memorial Church (東門巴克禮紀念教會)
item.description: Tainan East Gate Barclay Memorial Church (東門巴克禮紀念教會) A PCT congregation in 台南中會 (presbytery of Tainan, Taiwan). Not a U.S. TPC church.

item.title: Chunglun Presbyterian Church (中崙教會)
item.description: Chunglun Presbyterian Church (中崙教會) A PCT congregation in 七星中會 (Taipei). Not 台南東門巴克禮紀念教會.

item.title: George Leslie Mackay (馬偕)
item.description: George Leslie Mackay (馬偕) George Leslie Mackay (偕叡理 / 馬偕, 21 March 1844 – 2 June 1901) was a Canadian Presbyterian missionary, the first Presbyterian missionary to northern Taiwan (Tamsui, 1872).
